name: Bad End Cinderella
source:
"If you aren't here for a sad story, then why are you here at all?"

A classic tale, tainted with the dinge of regret and obsession. What happens to the prince who lets his fairytale ending slip right through his fingers?

And to what lengths is he willing to go to get it back?

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240604133914/https://sauceco.itch.io/bad-end-cinderella]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“如果你不是来听一个悲伤的故事，那你究竟为什么而来？”

一则经典童话，染上了悔恨与执念的阴霾。当王子让童话般的结局从指缝间溜走，他会变成什么模样？

而为了将其夺回，他又愿意走到哪一步？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240604133914/https://sauceco.itch.io/bad-end-cinderella]itch.io[/url]]
